name: Orai

queries.query: Orai Uttar Pradesh official cadastral parcel map land records GIS plot map Jalaun
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official Jalaun district land-records page, which identifies UP Bhulekh as the state land-records portal and identifies the land-record officer location as Orai. It also found the official UP Bhunaksha map portal and the UP registration department map-service entry points.

queries.result: Hindi first-party discovery found the UP Revenue Board Hindi service page describing Bhulekh khatauni/khasra and Bhulekh bhu-naksha/shajra services, and the official Hindi Jalaun district land-records page.

freshResearch.method: Separate English and Hindi first-party discovery followed by bounded TLS-verified GETs and inspection of the public Bhunaksha JavaScript/configuration. No credentials, private tokens, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe-field request, or TLS disablement was used.

portalsFound.operator: Jalaun District Administration, Government of Uttar Pradesh
portalsFound.observation: Official district service page directs users to UP Bhulekh and describes computerized land-record services; it gives the Land Record Officer location as Collectorate, Orai. This evidences the local/district land-record custodian, not an open parcel geometry response.

portalsFound.operator: Revenue Council, Government of Uttar Pradesh / NIC
portalsFound.observation: Official public map viewer loaded and its current JavaScript exposed level metadata plus MapInfo plot-at-coordinate, plot-by-number, plot-info, and v1/khasramap/plot routes. No successful anonymous plot response was obtained.

portalsFound.operator: Stamp and Registration Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
portalsFound.observation: Official department page exposes rural property/land map and urban property/land GIS map service links; no parcel geometry response was verified.

requests.assessment: TLS-verified fetch succeeded; official page and its Hindi counterpart were inspected.

Bounded anonymous TLS-verified request timed out after 20 seconds with no response. This is not evidence of map extent miss, login wall, or citywide absence; no retry with disabled verification was attempted.
